title: CAP Theorem and Caching in System Design Simplified 2026 | Distributed System | Scaler

title: Relational Data Modelling | Schema Design Using Linkedin | Exclusive Tips & Tricks 2026

Needs a guide to translate SQL/RDBMS terms ('select star from...', 'entity') into Google Sheets tabs, but the underlying design logic (how to model many-to-many with a link sheet) is directly reusable. Note: this exact segment is duplicated inside both 8telu1SoCKM and 895XCPFr4-k - this standalone version is the best copy to point kids/teacher to.
